dialogues.title: В малой группе: уточнить и обосновать
dialogues.prompt: You missed question five. Ask your partner to read the clue aloud and then ask where you can find the answer.
dialogues.answer: Could you read the clue out loud, please? Could you tell me where we can find the answer?

phrases.phrase: Could you read the clue out loud?
phrases.example: Could you read the last sentence out loud?

phrases.phrase: Could you read it word for word?
phrases.meaning: Можешь прочитать это слово в слово?
phrases.pattern: Word for word — дословно, без пересказа.
phrases.example: Could you repeat the instructions word for word?

dialogues.title: Договорись, кто за кем заедет
dialogues.prompt: Ask politely whether your partner can pick you up, then find out what time they plan to leave.
dialogues.answer: Would you mind picking me up at my mum’s? Could you tell me what time you’re planning to leave?

phrases.phrase: Could you pick me up on the way?
phrases.meaning: Можешь заехать за мной по дороге?
phrases.pattern: Pick someone up — заехать за кем-то, забрать.
phrases.example: Could you pick me up on your way to the station?

phrases.phrase: Have you worked out how you’re getting there?
phrases.meaning: Ты уже решил, как туда доберёшься?
phrases.pattern: Work out how + подлежащее + глагол — разобраться, как что-то сделать.
phrases.example: Have you worked out how you’re getting to the airport?

dialogues.title: Попроси преподавателя о конкретной обратной связи
dialogues.prompt: Ask the tutor to point out one specific mistake and give you a chance to say it again.
dialogues.answer: Could you point out one thing I could say more naturally? Would it be all right if I tried again?

phrases.phrase: Could you give me a more natural phrase and let me try again?
phrases.meaning: Можешь предложить более естественную фразу и дать мне попробовать ещё раз?
phrases.example: Could you suggest a clearer opening and let me try again?

phrases.phrase: Could you be more specific about the speaking goal?
phrases.meaning: Можешь точнее сформулировать цель по устной речи?
phrases.pattern: Be more specific about + тема, которую нужно уточнить.
phrases.example: Could you be more specific about the problem?

dialogues.title: Четыре формы будущего
dialogues.prompt: Make plans for a play. Give a timetable, an arrangement, an earlier intention and an offer you make during the conversation.
dialogues.answer: The performance starts at seven. I’m meeting Alex outside the theatre at six. I’m going to book the tickets tonight. Do you need a lift? I’ll pick you up.

phrases.phrase: I’m meeting my friend at the theatre on Friday.
phrases.meaning: В пятницу я встречаюсь с другом у театра.
phrases.example: I’m meeting my conversation partner on Tuesday.

dialogues.title: Экодом и полезные технологии
dialogues.prompt: Continue the dialogue with your plans for an eco-house. Say what you’ve already decided, what you’ve arranged for Friday and what you can offer to do now.
dialogues.answer: We’re going to improve the insulation first. A technician is coming to check the smart meter on Friday. I’ll send you the energy readings now.

phrases.phrase: We’re going to improve the insulation first.
phrases.pattern: Going to — намерение, которое уже сформировалось.
phrases.example: We’re going to replace the windows next month.

phrases.phrase: A technician is coming to check the smart meter on Friday.
phrases.meaning: В пятницу придёт мастер проверить умный счётчик.
phrases.pattern: Present Continuous + день — договорённость о визите.
phrases.example: A plumber is coming to fix the shower on Monday.

dialogues.title: Мои занятия и цели в английском
dialogues.prompt: Tell your tutor how you’ll practise next week. Include a prior intention, a booked session and a decision you make while speaking.
dialogues.answer: I’m going to practise writing clearer emails. I’m meeting my conversation partner on Tuesday. Actually, I’ll write a short draft tonight.

phrases.phrase: Where will you use your English outside class?
phrases.meaning: Где ты будешь использовать английский вне занятий?
phrases.pattern: Will + начальная форма глагола — вопрос о будущем.
phrases.example: Where will you use these phrases at work?

phrases.phrase: I’d also like to write concise emails that sound natural to international colleagues.
phrases.meaning: Я также хотел бы писать короткие письма, которые звучат естественно для иностранных коллег.
phrases.pattern: I’d like to + глагол — что хочется делать или чему хочется научиться.
phrases.example: I’d like to give shorter updates during meetings.

dialogues.title: Фильм, мнение и вежливое несогласие
dialogues.prompt: Your partner loved the ending. Acknowledge their opinion, disagree gently and give one specific reason.
dialogues.answer: I see what you mean. The twist was surprising, but it felt rushed to me because the characters barely had time to react.

phrases.meaning: Понимаю, что ты имеешь в виду.
phrases.pattern: Покажи, что понял логику человека, и затем назови свою оговорку.
phrases.example: I see what you mean, but I found the ending confusing.

phrases.phrase: My reservation is that the final twist felt underdeveloped.
phrases.meaning: Меня смущает, что финальный поворот показался недоработанным.
phrases.pattern: My reservation is that + предложение — сдержанное возражение.
phrases.example: My reservation is that the schedule leaves us very little time.

dialogues.title: Экодом и полезные технологии
dialogues.prompt: Your partner wants to install underfloor heating first. Acknowledge the idea, then argue for another priority and explain why.
dialogues.answer: I can see why you’d choose underfloor heating. I’d start with insulation, though. The house loses a lot of heat through the walls.

phrases.pattern: It depends on + фактор, который влияет на решение.
phrases.example: It depends on how much heat the house loses.

phrases.phrase: Changing the thermostat and reducing heat loss might be more practical.
phrases.meaning: Заменить термостат и снизить потери тепла, возможно, практичнее.
phrases.pattern: Might be more practical — предложить альтернативу без категоричности.
phrases.example: Taking the train might be more practical during rush hour.

dialogues.title: Договорись, кто за кем заедет
dialogues.prompt: Your partner wants to drive at peak time. Acknowledge their point, then politely suggest taking the train or leaving earlier.
dialogues.answer: I see why driving would be easier with Sam. I’m not sure about leaving that late, though. Would it work if we left half an hour earlier?

phrases.phrase: I’m not sure about leaving that late, though.
phrases.meaning: Но я сомневаюсь, стоит ли выезжать так поздно.
phrases.pattern: I’m not sure about + -ing — мягко озвучить сомнение.
phrases.example: I’m not sure about booking that early, though.

phrases.phrase: Would it work if we left half an hour earlier?
phrases.meaning: Получится, если мы выедем на полчаса раньше?
phrases.pattern: Would it work if we + Past Simple — предложить вариант и проверить, подходит ли он.
phrases.example: Would it work if we moved the lesson to Friday?
